statement: The prevalence of prenatal complications is higher among infants who experienced SUID compared to those with congenital anomalies, birth injuries, respiratory distress syndrome, or prematurity as recorded in ncfrp_v51.
rationale: This design uses a case-case comparison within the NFR-CRS (ncfrp_v51) to compare the prevalence of prenatal complications between SUID cases and other fetal/neonatal conditions. The absence of a denominator source limits the analysis to proportions among cases only.
prior_art: None in the inputs; while existing claims discuss various risk factors for SUID, none directly address whether prenatal complications are more prevalent specifically among SUID cases compared to other adverse outcomes.
required_concepts: Congenital anomalies, birth injuries, respiratory distress syndrome, or prematurity
cannot_establish: incidence or risk of SUID, causal inference due to observational nature.
